conceptual_checks: Multiple fixed physical delays are distinct from acquisition frequency and arrival latency.
Lag-window coverage is not a sufficient-history guarantee.
Common-clock, acquisition/arrival availability and causal alignment are explicit.
Interpolation and held values are not presented as fresh or recovered observations.
Current-state conditioning/prefix and missing targets require additional treatment.
Irregular observation encoding with fixed-grid rollout is distinct from irregular-step propagation.
All extension routes are clearly described as requiring changed interfaces, fitting and validation.
